ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a localized high-intensity (white/grey) cluster on the right lobe tip, resulting in a low global contrast ratio of approximately 1:9 light-to-dark.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast mottled white/grey region located at the distal 15% of the right fluke lobe; scattered low-density white speckling across the central ventral region; the remainder of the visible surface consists of solid high-density dark pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal angle of 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits extreme macro-serrations consisting of six distinct finger-like protrusions separated by deep valleys; right lobe trailing edge shows irregular micro-serrations with low pixel-amplitude variations along a generally linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep from the peduncle to the distal tips; the left lobe trajectory is highly discontinuous, defined by a series of individual convex arcs.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-intensity white pixel spots forming a circular-mottled texture at the distal edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, light-colored vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the central ventral surface and upper peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme structural irregularity on the left lobe characterized by deep gaps between segments; the right lobe tip exhibits a textured, calloused appearance with heavy white pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'shredded' or 'finger-like' morphology of the left fluke lobe trailing edge.
